title: Comparative Study for Course Recommendation System
desc: Research Lead & Full-Stack Developer for a course recommendation system. I led a team in benchmarking SVD, SVD++, NMF, and k-NN models on 43,000+ records, then developed a hybrid RAG recommender system using Next.js, FastAPI, and pgvector. Our findings and implementation were published in the ACM Digital Library under the 14th International Conference on Advances in Information Technology (IAIT).

title: Kanban Board
desc: Task management Platform where users can create, edit and delete tasks. It also allows customization of task statuses. This project was developed using Vue.js, Spring Boot,  MySQL, Docker and JWT.

title: Employees Management
desc: Website that designed to collect personal opinions from employees to help improve the company's environment. It also includes features such as user authentication to ensure proper access.

title: Simon Says Game
desc: Single-player game where the system generates a random sequence of colors, and the user needs to replicate the sequence by selecting the colors in the correct order.
